measurement.baseline: Current actual synchronous compatibility resolver versus actual async lease selection+verifyLoaded, with the same canonical selected bytes and independent original file read counters. This is a controlled API/work comparison, not exact historical provider throughput.
measurement.inputs: Small1.5MiB plus32KiB tokenizer; other scopes44MiB plus32KiB tokenizer, including a conservative sibling graph and external data. Synthetic graph bytes are hashed, never passed to a model provider.
measurement.cache: Fresh child processes. Files have just been prepared, so filesystem page-cache warmth is explicit. Cold means no prior lease in that process; warm primes once outside measurement then repeats three mutable selection/post-load cycles. No device-cold claim.
measurement.observed: Bytes/read calls/opened files from actual original sync/async descriptors, independent producer verification/coalescing/file/byte counters, raw CPU/wall, sampled heap, before/after GC, process-lifetime RSS, timer heartbeat and monitorEventLoopDelay.
measurement.outcome: Eight concurrent clients perform16 sync hash passes versus two shared async passes:738721792→92340224 bytes, with14 coalesced requests. Three warm cycles retain six hash passes/277020672 read bytes in both arms. Single/small/warm async wall overhead is retained. Event-loop responsiveness improves while full mutable freshness is preserved.
measurement.limitations: Heap is sampled rather than an exact peak. Lifetime RSS includes fixture preparation. No trained-model numerical or end-to-end inference throughput claim. Metadata planning and per-chunk SHA256 still execute on the main thread.

nativeClosure.operation: Actual ONNX installation and native InferenceSession load/run/release. Declared nested/weights.custom and selected tokenizer are inventoried; a malformed unselected sibling is excluded by the qualified installation receipt. Output tensor7 is independently expected. Same-size preserved-mtime external replacement fails ERR_ONNX_ARTIFACT_INTEGRITY after release.

coverage.authority: Native directory/stat admission results are explicitly injected over real ordinary files; no local symlinks are created. The real non-file and late-member mutations exercise actual filesystem changes. Existing contained-descriptor physical authority remains with its original capable-Windows cohort.
coverage.existing: Existing31-case controls retain unknown requester isolation, same-stat weight/tokenizer/external edits, exact sync/async digest parity, failed initialization/raw pipeline release, canceled verification/sibling coalescing, deferred adapter close, byte/progress limits and interrupted native installation.
coverage.serial: All24 measured children and three actual native closure/install consumers use the existing serial runtime owner; no resource or latency threshold is raised.

historicalPaths: Author-workspace .tmp/.testLogs paths are provenance, not deliverables promised in clean checkouts.
excluded: Editor/Tantivy work, optional backends, cold-device performance, model numerical/inference requalification and release acceptance remain separate.
